title: Scalar-basis decomposition of finite-to-Qbar derived extension units
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite intermediate field E of its algebraic closure. Use the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic-closure coefficient ring and its pullback to every scheme Z from def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category. There exist one small indexing type I and, on the unbounded derived Omega-module category of each Z, central natural endomorphisms tau(Z,i). For every derived E-module M and every chosen I-copower of M, the map from that copower to the restriction of derived scalar extension of M, with i-th leg the extension adjunction unit followed by restriction of tau(Z,i), is invertible. For every scheme morphism f:X→Y, derived Omega-direct-image carries tau(X,i) at every M to tau(Y,i) at its image. This is an algebraic scalar compatibility statement; it asserts no preservation of infinite coproducts by direct image.

source.place: Finite-basis restricted-regular-module and extension-unit calculation; infinite-basis extension for the finite-support ring model, as planned in steps 1–3 of prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-basechange-compatibility.

proof.text: Choose an algebraic E-basis of Omega. A finite-field-valued continuous function takes values in a finite-dimensional E-subspace after forming the compositum with E. Its finitely many Hamel coordinates are continuous by finite-dimensional topological linear algebra. Finite covers preserve finite support. Hence restriction of the regular condensed Omega-module is the coproduct of regular E-modules, with basis-vector summand maps.

Pull this decomposition to each scheme along the monoidal inverse-image functor. Tensor with M and identify each summand map with the extension unit followed by its basis scalar. Exact coproducts make extension exact and descend this decomposition termwise to the unbounded derived category. The coproduct assertion is independent of the chosen coproduct by uniqueness of colimits.

The scalar endomorphisms are central. Pullback carries the same global coefficient scalars to each other, by its monoidal unit and coefficient square. Transpose this identity through the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction to obtain scalar compatibility of direct image. No direct-image preservation of infinite sums is used.

proof_origin.place: F3 scalar-basis and bounded-below coproduct route, 2026-10-16

lean.statement:
theorem condensedQbar_derived_scalar_basis :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1))
      (τ : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, I → CatCenter (DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) Z)))),
      (∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Z)))
        [HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ M)],
        IsIso (Sigma.desc (f := fun _ : I ↦ M) fun i ↦
          (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction (coefficientMap
            (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).unit.app M ≫
          (Mod.comap (coefficientMap
            (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((τ Z i).app ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap
                (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl ℓ E) Z)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj M)))) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : I)
        (M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X))),
        R((f)_*⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧).map ((τ X i).app M) =
          (τ Y i).app (R((f)_*⟦Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ⟧).obj M))
